archives.note: ONE archive serves all three platforms. Windows 10 and 11 ship bsdtar, so `tar -xf` opens the tar.gz there as it does on Linux and macOS.

install.pip_source: the operator's PIP_INDEX_URL wins; VERO_PIP_INDEX is used only when there is none

warnings: The service drives a PHYSICAL device. A write moves it.
By default no route requires an access token.
The simulator is opt-in and only start_web.py can reach it; the CLI always drives real hardware.
description: A cross-platform controller for AIKE's Vero and Mira devices: BLE, telemetry, motion control, recording and a web UI. Windows / Linux / macOS, one tree.

devices.detection: A device is identified by the PREFIX of its serial (Vero: ALVX/UMVX, Mira: ALMI/UMMI), so no individual unit's identifier is ever needed to match a device.
